text:
nina: Heads-up: found an inconsistency on the /v1/generate API ref. The JSON example uses `max_output_tokens` but the OpenAPI and SDKs expect `max_tokens`. This caused the TypeScript SDK validation to silently ignore the setting.

nina: Current example on page:```json
{
  "model": "gpt-std",
  "prompt": "Summarize this...",
  "max_output_tokens": 150
}
```

paul: Oof. Is this from an older naming convention? I remember a rename during the schema cleanup. The generator should have updated examples but it looks like that page was hand-edited.

tara: I can patch the page and update JS/TS/Python snippets. Also should add a small migration note explaining the param rename so customers searching for `max_output_tokens` see the new key.

paul: Please also audit other generate examples for the same bad key. Maybe run a grep across docs for `max_output_tokens` and add a lint rule to catch deprecated keys in examples.

nina: Good idea. I ran: `rg "max_output_tokens" docs/ -n` and found 3 pages. I'll include fixes in the PR.

paul: When you open the PR, regenerate the SDK snippets and run the snippet snapshot test. Last time we forgot to regenerate and CI passed but prod examples were stale.

tara: Will do. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/881 (WIP). Changes: replace `max_output_tokens` -> `max_tokens`, update code snippets, add migration note at docs/migration/generate-param-changes.md, and add a docs-linter rule to flag `max_output_tokens` in examples.

nina: Add a tiny code example for TS showing the typed param:```ts
await client.generate({ model: 'gpt-std', prompt: '...', max_tokens: 150 })
```

paul: Also add a unit test in docs-tooling that parses all example JSON and checks keys against the canonical schema; if unknown keys are present, fail. That will catch misspellings / legacy names.

sdk-ci: FYI: the TypeScript SDK tests currently have a skipped test referencing `max_output_tokens`. Once the docs change lands, we should unskip and assert telemetry picks up the param.

tara: Thanks, will notify SDK owners in the PR description. docs-bot: deploy-preview created: https://deploy-preview-881--docs.redwood.ai/generate-param-keys (auto).

nina: After merge, let's run a quick site search for both keys and confirm redirects / migration note covers the old name. Leaving thread open until PR merged and linter added.

paul: Agreed. I'll review and help with the linter commit.
